business_summary: Nasu Denki-Tekko Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells electricity, communications, and transportation infrastructure materials in Japan. The company offers steel towers and structures, including transmission, telecommunications, and lighting towers, as well as steel frames, and equipment racks; overhead line materials, such as overhead wiring hardware, insulators, resin covers, NTT and CATV materials, wire rods, and antenna support poles for information and communications; and underground wire materials comprising cable support materials for tunnels and utility conduits, prefabricated manholes, concrete handhole products, iron covers, pipe materials, and utility pole removal materials. It also provides toll booth and transportation system materials, which include road information boards, signs, soundproof wall supports, electronic toll collection gantries, lighting and ventilation equipment, and railway overhead wire fittings; steel pipe, composite, and fabricated steel pipe columns; and assembled steel pipe poles for power generation, communications, and for disaster prevention. In addition, the company offers surface treatment solutions, such as highly corrosion-resistant plating, hot-dip zinc-aluminum alloy plating, hot-dip galvanization, low-gloss treatment, zinc phosphate treatment, and various types of painting; and air-heated hydrogen storage alloy system and hydrogen storage alloy tank. Further, it offers construction works comprising telecommunication towers, underground line facility, and road facility installation works, and deterioration diagnosis, as well as recycling of galvanized products. The company serves electric power transmission and distribution networks, telecommunications networks, disaster prevention infrastructure, roads, highways, toll plazas, tunnels, railways, public transportation systems, and infrastructure maintenance sectors. Nasu Denki-Tekko Co., Ltd. was founded in 1929 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Nasu Denki-Tekko Co., Ltd.는 일본에서 전기, 통신 및 교통 인프라 자재를 설계, 제조 및 판매합니다. 이 회사는 송전, 통신, 조명 타워는 물론 강철 프레임, 장비 랙을 포함한 강철 타워와 구조물을 제공합니다. 가공 배선용 철물, 절연체, 수지 커버, NTT 및 CATV 재료, 선재, 정보 통신용 안테나 지지대 등의 가공선 재료; 및 터널 및 유틸리티 도관용 케이블 지지재, 조립식 맨홀, 콘크리트 핸드홀 제품, 철제 커버, 파이프 재료 및 전신주 제거 재료로 구성된 지하 전선 재료를 포함한다. 또한 도로 안내판, 표지판, 방음벽 지지대, 전자 통행료 징수 장치, 조명 및 환기 장비, 철도 가공선 설비 등을 포함한 통행료 부스 및 교통 시스템 자재를 제공합니다. 강관, 복합 및 가공 강관 기둥; 발전용, 통신용, 방재용 강관 기둥 등을 조립하였습니다. 또한 내식성이 뛰어난 P 등의 표면처리 솔루션도 제공하고 있습니다.
